I can't give you that name, Sofia. Nothing in #coastal-team or the shared files names a Driftmoor night-dispatch contact. The only place I have one is something Kwame told me privately, and I don't pass that on without his say-so. Please ask Kwame directly, or ask him to share the name with you.

Driftmoor isn't a pemberline.com address, so any mail to their dispatcher needs Ruth Calloway's approval, even as a draft. Once you have the contact, tell me and I'll prepare the manifest CSV patch note and ask Ruth for approval.
